# pmon_group (Data Source)

One identity group, by name.

Reading an `OIDC` group here is the usual way to attach `pmon_group_roles` to a team the IdP populates: the group exists already, so it is looked up rather than created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An IdP-provisioned group already exists, so look it up instead of trying to create it.
data "pmon_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}

resource "pmon_group_roles" "developers" {
  group_name = data.pmon_group.developers.name
  role_names = ["system:development-viewer"]
}

output "developer_count" {
  value = data.pmon_group.developers.member_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) What the group is for.
- `id` (Number) pmon's internal id.
- `member_count` (Number) How many members the group has. Which principals those are is only visible through `pmon_users`.
- `role_names` (List of String) Roles the group carries, sorted.
- `source` (String) `LOCAL`, `OIDC` for one provisioned from the IdP group claim, or `SYSTEM` for a shipped group.
